calls.title: Doug Cherry and Ashley Stirrup + Jeremy Dorn
calls.summary: The team discussed transitioning to a managed warehouse model in Europe to comply with GDPR and improve data privacy for their customers. Current services include AWS-hosted Clickhouse Cloud and plans to replicate ingestion services in Dublin. The goal is to support both free and paid customers, particularly pro users, while ensuring existing customers can continue using their own warehouses if preferred. They acknowledged that around 30% of their revenue comes from Europe, indicating the importance of this transition. Technical infrastructure improvements include deploying Kafka in Europe and optimizing cloud costs with AWS assistance. The meeting aimed at strategizing for compliance, cost management, and enhancing operational efficiency.
calls.keywords: AWS, Kafka, Terraform, GDPR, Clickhouse Cloud, Managed Warehouse
calls.action_items:
